text:
Alex: noticing a perf regression on prod after the multi-variant rollout. p50 fine, p99 jumps ~2x during peak. GPU utilization is spiky and KV hit rate dropped ~18%.
Maria: thanks for the flag. any repro traces or perf profiles? logs?
Alex: spotted in the tracing dashboard. here's a snippet from the sampler:
```
{ "trace_id": "t-9f3a", "batch_size": 3, "variants": ["v1_q4", "v2_fp16", "v1_q4"], "queue_wait_ms": 120 }
```
Alex: batches are more fragmented now because compat sets are small; runtime creates mixed-variant batches and then falls back to serial exec for mismatches, hurting throughput.
Devon: can you paste the kernel selection log for one of those traces? i want to see fallback to generic kernel.
Alex: sure, from /var/log/runtime/profiler:
```
[2026-02-28 14:12:01] SELECT_KERNEL model=v1 arch=llama n_ctx=2048 token_dist=avg -> kernel=fast_attn_q4
[2026-02-28 14:12:01] COMPAT_CHECK variants=[v1_q4,v2_fp16] -> compatible=false
[2026-02-28 14:12:01] BATCH_FORMED size=3 -> exec_mode=mixed_fallback_serial
```
Maria: that explains the KV cache thrash — mixed_fallback_serial invalidates prefix reuse across seqs.
Senthil: what were the queue policy and token budget settings when this happened?
Alex: current queue policy=latency_floor, token_budget=1024. workload is chatty small seqs + occasional long completions.
Linda: maybe token_budget too small for combining compat peers. If budget is low and variants differ, scheduler picks earlier execs instead of waiting for compatible peers.
Devon: propose two experiments:
1) temporarily bump token_budget -> 4096 for a canary pool, keep latency_floor.
2) expand compat_set heuristic to allow compatibility across quantization boundaries when kernel compatible (i.e., treat q4 and fp16 as compatible if kernel supports both).
Maria: +1. Also add an adaptive hold window: if we see >10% fragmentation for a model, increase hold_ms by 5ms for that model only.
Alex: logged an APICall to create a canary: /deploy canary pool=canary-eu token_budget=4096 compat_override=true
CI-Bot: Canary deployment started: canary-eu -> 3 nodes. Watch metrics: infra/runtime/throughput, infra/runtime/p99_latency, infra/runtime/kv_hit_rate.
Senthil: don't forget to capture kernel selection histograms and the batch composition (variant histogram per batch). add these to the canary trace capture.
Linda: I'll add a small profiler hook to emit "batch.variant_mix" metric with counts; canary will show if mixes drop.
Devon: if compat_override reduces correctness or increases regressions, fallback plan: rollback canary and instead try a queue-policy change: switch to throughput_priority for heavy models only.
Maria: also add a synthetic load test: replay 1h of peak traffic but force variant randomness to match production distribution. run before and after canary.
Alex: I'll run the replay and post results. initial hypothesis: throughput should recover ~15% and kv_hit_rate recover ~12% if compat expansion works.
Maria: tentative action items:
- Alex: run replay + post perf diffs (p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_rate, batch_size distribution)
- Linda: add batch.variant_mix metric and enable kernel histograms on canary
- Senthil: patch compat heuristic (feature flag) and prepare rollback
- Devon: monitor canary, watch for correctness/regression alerts
CI-Bot: Replay job queued: replay/1825309123-compat-canary (ETA ~12m)
Alex: thanks, will post when replay finishes. tagging @Devon @Maria for visibility :thumbsup:
Maria: thanks — let's keep the canary at 10% traffic and ramp slowly. if p99 improves and no correctness alerts, we can roll to 50%.
Alex: update: replay finished. quick numbers: throughput +13%, p99 down 18%, kv_hit_rate +11% with compat_override=true. logs show mixed batches reduced from 28% -> 6%.
Devon: that's promising. any unexpected error rates?
Alex: none in canary. a few minor increases in CPU on host due to extra compat checks (~3%).
Senthil: sounds acceptable. plan to merge feature flag and start phased rollout tomorrow unless anyone objects.
Maria: no objections. please include rollout playbook and rollback steps in the PR.
Linda: adding notes to the PR about perf tradeoffs and metric dashboards to monitor.
Alex: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4827 — includes compat heuristic, token_budget config, canary config.
Devon: I'll watch dashboards during rollout and ping if anomalies.
Maria: great work team :tada:
